title: Record the surface and run the project verify
question: what does the console pane render, case by case, from the join the extension ships?

contract.reason: reason is present only when the digest lacks the code the message carried, and code is absent only when the message carried none
contract.rendered: the pane renders state and findings and nothing else: no cause, no element, no remedy and no unattributed wording

capture.write: an armed run re-derives every case from the join and the pane and writes this file only when a value moved, so a default run is a read and a second armed run writes no byte
capture.reproduces: each case’s state, its findings and its rendered lines below are derived at the head that carries them from the four files named under sources — the join over the shipped digest, and the pane over the join’s answer — so a second run at the same path re-derives the same bytes, and this record carries no clock, no commit and no absolute path; every cases[].input and every cases[].why are this suite’s own fixture constants, not values read from the tree, and so are schema, milestone, task, title, question, the whole contract and this prose, and contract.states restates the join’s three state words rather than reading the namespace the join publishes

fixture.caseInputs: every cases[].input — the diagnostics the fixture hands over, or the absence of a capture — and every cases[].why are this suite’s own fixture constants, not values read from the tree; what this record derives about a case is its state, its findings and its rendered lines
fixture.messageTexts: the message texts are exemplars written in the capture’s payload shape, not strings a capture recorded: what this record measures about them is the payload key set, the code extraction and the digest lookup, so a capture that read different text would move the recorded text and not the shape
